description: Create a car-for-sale listing for a PRIVATE seller on AutoPrivado, only on behalf of and with the consent of the car's owner. Decodes the VIN (NHTSA vPIC) or Dutch plate (RDW), gives a rule-based price estimate, writes the listing in EN/DE/IT/ES/FR/NL/PL and a missing-info checklist. The listing page goes live on autoprivado.com; returns its URL and a secret edit URL (give the edit URL only to the seller). AutoPrivado never posts to portals: the seller publishes on each portal himself with the posting kit (kitUrl). Limited per client and per day (free service).

alsoIn.description: Optional: also sell in these other markets. Posting kits are written in each market's language and the car appears in searches there.

altPrice.description: Optional second price for markets in the other currency (PLN for PL when the seller uses EUR, EUR when the seller is in PL). Never converted; without it those kits show no price.

contact.description: Public contact shown on the listing (optional; it is public)

country.description: Country where the car is sold

newPrice.description: Approximate list price when new (EUR), improves the estimate for VINs

notes.description: Seller's own words (kept in the original language)

plate.description: Dutch licence plate (NL only, RDW lookup)

price.description: Asking price: EUR, or PLN (złoty) when country is PL. No conversion.

vehicle.description: Overrides: make, model, year, fuel, powerKw, body …

name: create_listing
title: Create a private car listing
